# Draft cover letter

Dear Editor,

We submit “Staple Dispersion and Curvature Spillover in SU(2) Lattice Gauge
Theory.”  The paper defines a gauge-invariant Fréchet dispersion of the
complementary transports around a link and identifies it with residual local
geodesic-quadratic energy.  On the smallest open four-dimensional block with
interior links, it then gives exact rational certificates for the dependent
Gaussian dispersion law and for the minimum external curvature required to
lift a prescribed centered staple displacement.  The latter quadratic form is
strictly positive, quantifying why an ideal star-local contraction cannot be
realized without curvature spillover.

The manuscript clearly separates classical ingredients from the
lattice-specific synthesis and states that it makes no continuum or mass-gap
claim.  Code, exact certificate data, and tests accompany the submission.

Sincerely,

The authors
